description: The 36-to-50 normalisation, declared and exercised on four rows written out literally at the 36 characters the shipped data measures. This is the case that proves the pad FIRES rather than merely being configured. app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy declares XREF-CARD-NUM X(16) + XREF-CUST-ID 9(09) + XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11) + FILLER PIC X(14) = 50 bytes, and every row of app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt is exactly 36 - the filler span is simply absent from the data. The harness refuses a 36-character seed for this dataset unless the case declares CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50, so deleting the normalisation from this file fails the case immediately and loudly; and each expected line is the row followed by exactly fourteen spaces, so a pad of the wrong width fails it too. CVACT03Y has twelve consumers, which makes a wrong offset found here a codebase-wide signal rather than a local one. The four seeded rows are fixture rows 0, 1, 2 and 49 verbatim, so the browse spans the cluster from its lowest key to its highest. Ten lines, which is 2 + (2 x 4): app/cbl/CBACT03C.cbl:71 opens with the banner, every record is then displayed TWICE - first at :96, on the '00' arm inside 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT, and again at :78 in the mainline immediately after the PERFORM of that paragraph - and :85 closes with END OF EXECUTION, which is reachable only because the CLOSE at :138 reported '00'. The doubling is a defect of the source and is preserved deliberately (practice B5): CBACT02C's inner display is commented out and CBACT01C routes through a labelled paragraph, so CBACT03C is the one reader of the three that emits each record image twice, and a translation that tidied it would emit six lines here instead of ten. Nothing is injected: app/jcl/READXREF.jcl STEP05 is a bare EXEC PGM=CBACT03C with no PARM, so jobParameters is empty, and a BATCH_JOB case cannot carry a ForcedOutcome at all because that member belongs to ParityCase.ScreenRequest - the arranged backend behaviour is therefore the consumer's Scenario.clean() entry for case14, which is precisely why RETURN-CODE is 0 and why no ERROR READING XREFFILE, FILE STATUS IS: NNNN or ABENDING PROGRAM line appears. expectedWrites is empty as a positive assertion that this job writes nothing whatever - the prompt-mandated name says Update and the verified source performs no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE - and expectedFinalState repeats the four seeded rows unchanged at the padded width. Every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of app/cbl/CBACT03C.cbl cross-checked against app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy, app/jcl/READXREF.jcl and app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt; none of it is captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL, which is empirically impossible in this environment (AAP risk R-A, practice B12).
